steps: Book a marriage license appointment with the San Francisco County Clerk and submit the application when you book; it cannot be rescheduled and there are no refunds.
Go together to City Hall, Room 160, each with an unexpired government photo ID, and pay $129 (public or confidential license).
Reserve a City Hall civil ceremony for 6 guests or fewer; walk-ins are not allowed, and the license is not sold on your ceremony day.
Have the civil ceremony ($113) within 90 days of the license, with the original license and 1 witness for a public license.
If a County Clerk commissioner married you, the office files the documents for you; a certified copy of a public certificate is $19 from the Assessor-Recorder, 10 days after recording.

faq.q: How much does a courthouse wedding cost in San Francisco?
faq.a: As of Oct 29, 2026, the San Francisco County Clerk charges $129 for a marriage license (public or confidential, the same price) and $113 for a civil ceremony at City Hall: $242 in all. These are the new fees in effect since July 1, 2026. A ceremony off site, on a weekend or on a holiday is $336 ($186 when you reserve, $150 to the commissioner at the ceremony).

faq.q: Can you get married at City Hall in San Francisco?
faq.a: Yes: a commissioner from the Office of the County Clerk marries you at City Hall, by reservation, with 6 guests or fewer; walk-ins are not allowed. For more than 6 guests, or a weekend or holiday, the county says to book a space through City Hall Events.

faq.q: How do you get a marriage license in San Francisco?
faq.a: Book an appointment and submit the application when you book. Both of you go to City Hall, Room 160, each with an unexpired government photo ID; it takes 20 minutes to an hour. The license costs $129 and is valid for 90 days anywhere in California. You do not need to live in California or be a US citizen.

faq.q: Can you get married the same day in San Francisco?
faq.a: Not at City Hall: the clerk says marriage licenses are not available for purchase on the same day as your ceremony. Get the license at an earlier appointment, then bring the original to your ceremony (photocopies are not accepted).

faq.q: Do you need a witness for a San Francisco City Hall wedding?
faq.a: With a public license, bring 1 witness. A confidential license needs no witness, but you must be living together, and only the two of you can get the record. Both licenses cost $129.

steps5.title: Book your license appointment
steps5.text: Book with the County Clerk and submit the marriage license application when you book. A license appointment cannot be rescheduled, and there are no refunds.

steps5.title: Get your license
steps5.text: Both of you, at City Hall Room 160, each with an unexpired government photo ID; it takes 20 minutes to an hour. A confidential license is the same $129.

steps5.title: Reserve your ceremony
steps5.text: A City Hall civil ceremony is by reservation, for 6 guests or fewer; walk-ins are not allowed. The license is not sold on your ceremony day, so get it first.

steps5.title: Say your vows at City Hall
steps5.text: Arrive 15 minutes early with a photo ID each and the original license. A public license needs 1 witness; a confidential one needs none. Marry within 90 days of the license.

steps5.title: After the ceremony
steps5.text: If a County Clerk commissioner married you, the office files the documents for you. A certified copy of a public certificate is $19 from the Assessor-Recorder, 10 days after recording.

tips.t: A City Hall civil ceremony is for 6 guests or fewer. For a bigger group, or a weekend or holiday, the county sends you to City Hall Events to book a space.
